name: Ravioli with Shrimp, Mixed Mushrooms & Spicy Miso-Chive Butter Sauce

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and ravioli, and stir for a few seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
255 g cheese ravioli, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, and remove stems from portobello mushrooms; slice into ¼-inch thick strips.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sliced portobello and white mushrooms to the skillet along with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 (227g ) pkg sliced white mushrooms
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and chop chives into small pieces. Place in a small bowl along with miso paste, water, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small pkg chives
2 tbsp miso paste, white
2 tbsp water
2 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the mushrooms are soft, add shrimp to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 3-4 minutes.
Add drained ravioli, miso sauce, and more butter to the skillet. Stir until butter is melted and pasta is coated in sauce, about 1 minute; remove from heat.
To serve, divide ravioli, shrimp, and mushrooms between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
